---
title: "Code Map and Remaining Gaps"
description: "Where acquisition, evidence preparation, inference, scoring, and reporting live—and what is still missing."
---

::: {.lead}
The repository has reusable acquisition and benchmark seams, four supported
project commands, isolated model-family adapters, and several bespoke research
workflows. For a newcomer, **`vqa-frozen30` is the most complete end-to-end
workflow**; `vqa-gate` currently exposes preflight only, and there is no general
`vqa-score` command.
:::

Use [Start Here](index.qmd) to choose a baseline and the [Experiment
Ledger](experiment-ledger.qmd) to understand why it was chosen.

## System pipeline

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-system-pipeline
%%| fig-cap: "The repository pipeline from source-video acquisition through sanitized reports."
%%| fig-alt: "Top-to-bottom pipeline. Acquisition passes local media into label-blind evidence preparation. Prepared requests go to isolated model-family inference. Frozen predictions move across a label boundary into scoring. Only sanitized aggregate findings are committed to reports."
flowchart TD
  A[Acquisition<br/>resumable local media] --> P[Evidence preparation<br/>frames, manifests, requests]
  P --> I[Inference<br/>isolated family adapters]
  I --> S[Scoring<br/>labels joined after freeze]
  S --> R[Reports<br/>sanitized aggregates]
```

| Stage | Main tracked code | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Acquisition | [`youtube_dataset.py`][youtube-module], [`vqa_download.py`][download-module] | Media and runtime state stay local and ignored. |
| Evidence preparation | [`vqa_benchmark.py`][benchmark-module], [`vqa_gate.py`][gate-module], tracked configs | Questions and evidence are bound without reference labels in inference requests. |
| Inference | family runners plus [`vqa_frozen30_workflow.py`][frozen-workflow] | Heavy model runtimes are isolated; request/result identity is checked. |
| Scoring | [`vqa_evaluation.py`][evaluation-module] and experiment-specific scoring modules | Labels are joined only after predictions are frozen. |
| Reports | `docs/experiments/`, `reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/`, and these status pages | Commit sanitized summaries, never private runtime artifacts. |

The arrow sequence is operational, not a promise of a single universal
command. Only frozen-30 currently packages preparation, guarded execution,
resume/status, and scoring into one supported workflow.

## Supported commands {#supported-commands}

The four installed project scripts are declared in [`pyproject.toml`][pyproject].
After `uv sync`, inspect them with `uv run <command> --help`; do not launch a
large download or GPU run merely to explore the code.

| Command | Role | What a newcomer should know |
|---|---|---|
| `youtube-dataset-download` | Generic YouTube-ID/watch-URL acquisition | Reusable engine with `prepare`, `run`, `start`, and read-only `status` commands for a configured YouTube dataset. |
| `vqa-download` | TRECVID-specific acquisition adapter | Supplies repository-specific paths and operational defaults around the generic engine; commands can mutate ignored local runtime state. |
| `vqa-gate` | Small compatibility-gate entry point | Its public CLI exposes **`preflight` only**. The completed family runs used tested Python seams and adapters rather than a general one-command gate. |
| `vqa-frozen30` | Frozen-30 benchmark workflow | The most complete workflow: CPU preparation, read-only status, Whisper generation, transcript request binding, explicit condition authorization/run, resume controls, and scoring. |

There is **no general `vqa-score` CLI**. General scoring primitives live in
[`vqa_evaluation.py`][evaluation-module]; frozen-30 exposes its own `score`
action, and later experiments have purpose-built scoring modules or scripts.

## Code layers

| Layer | Representative paths | Intended reuse |
|---|---|---|
| Supported CLIs | `youtube_dataset.py`, `vqa_download.py`, `vqa_gate.py`, `vqa_frozen30_workflow.py` | Stable user entry points declared by `pyproject.toml`. |
| Reusable modules | [`vqa_benchmark.py`][benchmark-module], [`vqa_frozen30.py`][frozen-controls], [`vqa_evaluation.py`][evaluation-module], [`vqa_models.py`][model-module] | Evidence construction, manifests, fail-closed resume controls, evaluation, and shared prompt behavior. |
| Specialist adapters | [`vqa_transformers_runner.py`][transformers-runner], [`vqa_specialist_runner.py`][specialist-runner], [`vqa_omni_runner.py`][omni-runner], [`vqa_whisper.py`][whisper-runner], [`vqa_audio_runner.py`][audio-runner], [`vqa_seamless.py`][seamless-runner] | Isolated `python -m trec_video_2026.<module>` request/result adapters for pinned model families or modalities; they are not separate project scripts. |
| Bespoke experiment workflows | [`vqa_experiments/`][experiments-package] and `scripts/` experiment helpers | Frozen contracts, transport, scoring, and collection for a specific research question; reuse only after reading that experiment's report and limitations. |

The useful architectural split is between orchestration and adapters:
host-side code freezes requests and validates provenance, while model-family
runners import heavy dependencies only inside their pinned execution runtime.

## Repository map

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-repository-map
%%| fig-cap: "Repository map showing the tracked newcomer entry points and the ignored local-data boundary."
%%| fig-alt: "Tree diagram. The repository root contains pyproject and README entry points; source modules; configs and scripts; tests; dated experiment documentation and reports; and an ignored local data directory that must never be committed or linked from the report."
flowchart TD
  ROOT[Repository root] --> ENTRY[README + pyproject<br/>start and commands]
  ROOT --> SRC[src/trec_video_2026<br/>CLIs, modules, adapters]
  ROOT --> OPS[configs + scripts<br/>frozen inputs and helpers]
  ROOT --> EVID[docs + reports<br/>sanitized evidence]
  ROOT --> TESTS[tests<br/>contracts and tooling]
  ROOT --> LOCAL[data<br/>ignored local boundary]
```

| Path | Read it when… | Caution |
|---|---|---|
| [`README.md`][readme] and [`pyproject.toml`][pyproject] | You need the operating boundary or supported command names. | A help command is safer than starting work. |
| [`src/trec_video_2026/`][source-package] | You are changing reusable behavior, orchestration, or an adapter. | Identify the layer before widening an experiment-specific seam. |
| [`configs/vqa/`][configs] and [`scripts/`][scripts] | You need frozen run definitions or operational helpers. | Some helpers launch expensive or stateful work; inspect first. |
| [`docs/experiments/`][experiment-docs] | You need recent sanitized experiment contracts and results. | Compatibility reports may be superseded by quality reports. |
| [`reports/trecvid_vqa_2026/`][report-index] | You need the July 12 field guide or later analytical reports. | Historical recommendations are not the current default. |
| `tests/` | You are changing tracked behavior and need its executable contract. | This documentation task did not run or add application tests. |
| `data/` | A specifically authorized run requires the shared local dataset. | Ignored and private: never copy, stage, commit, or expose it. |

## Remaining gaps

These are issue **seeds**, not newly created GitHub issues. Validate and scope
them before implementation.

### Documentation seeds

- Add one safe, copy-paste walkthrough from `uv sync` through a read-only
  preflight/status inspection, without assuming dataset access.
- Document which experiment-specific modules are reusable contracts versus
  frozen historical workflows.
- Keep a small claim-to-report-to-code crosswalk as new experiments supersede
  older recommendations.
- Document the separate Quarto source, GitHub-readable Markdown, and
  self-contained HTML update procedure after the first render is reviewed.

### Engineering seeds

- Extend `vqa-gate` beyond `preflight` only if one general prepare/run/report
  contract can preserve the existing label and provenance boundaries.
- Decide whether a general `vqa-score` CLI is valuable, or whether scoring
  should remain owned by frozen workflows; do not silently expose labels to
  inference-side code.
- Consolidate the common request/result contract across Transformers,
  specialist, audio, and omni adapters without erasing required family-specific
  attestations.
- Turn the recommended question/evidence routing policy into a label-blind,
  versioned configuration with explicit fallback and non-regression gates.
- Define a cheap representative end-to-end smoke path before any larger local
  or rented-GPU run.

### Research seeds

- Measure 2026 performance when valid evaluation evidence becomes available;
  it is currently unknown.
- Validate lexical-speech, prosody, non-speech, counting, and visible-text
  routing prevalence on a larger label-blind question sample.
- Run a matched native-audio specialist benchmark with separate speech,
  prosody, non-speech, temporal, and visual-control strata.
- Re-evaluate Qwen3-Omni only with a strict output-complete run and a larger,
  predeclared panel; do not promote the 19/20 diagnostic.
- Design a different temporal selector only if it addresses the directed and
  dense-burst failure modes under a fixed evidence budget.
- Keep the independent human-oracle tier blocked until the required
  transcriber/reviewer provenance exists; track it in [open issue #19][issue19].

The current safe next action is therefore determined by the question: use the
[Experiment Ledger](experiment-ledger.qmd) for a research decision, or begin at
the supported-command table above for a code change.
